review_policy: Owner-designated review and merge authority for Brownie Runtime Release Readiness governance.

github_actor_separation_policy.policy: Brownie Phase Loop implementation PRs are authored and pushed by brownie-agent. Codex uses the owner account globalpocket to review and merge those PRs after required status checks pass.
github_actor_separation_policy.branch_protection_expectation: main keeps required pull request reviews, last-pusher approval, required status checks, enforced admins, force-push denial, deletion denial, and required conversation resolution enabled.
github_actor_separation_policy.temporary_exception_policy: If the implementation and review actors collapse to the same GitHub account, any branch-protection relaxation must be explicit, temporary, recorded, and restored immediately after the bounded operation.

reviews.scope: Release workflow, protected branch/tag policy, required status checks, remote CI provenance, and release gate binding.
Runtime-enforced permission model, VSIX thin-client boundary, MCP approval binding, and fail-closed authority separation.
Durable ledger payload contract, protocol/event canonicalization, replay/stale rejection, and schema migration evidence.
External AgentModes Mode Pack boundary, runtime policy materialization, and prevention of model-instruction authority escalation.
Owner-approved integrity authority, SHA256SUMS verification, release artifact provenance, and protected release tag policy.
Release Ready judgment logic, forbidden success claims, owner-governance evidence, and remaining cross-platform artifact blockers.

limitations: This review evidence does not remove the held cross-platform Linux/Windows artifact and smoke-test blocker.
This review evidence does not authorize public package publication; publication remains manual-gated by owner decision.
